empty.description: Have Captain do something on a schedule, such as summarizing what moved this week. Each run leaves a report here.

fields.briefPlaceholder: For example: Every Monday morning, look at last week's tasks and what each group did. Report what finished, what is stuck and why. If something needs doing, assign it in the right group. Post the summary in the Team group too.
fields.runByCaptain: Captain runs it, in a new session each time, with its own tools and model. To have results sent somewhere (a group, say), write that in the brief.

captainOff.supervisorOff: Its supervisor is switched off. While it is off, each time that comes is recorded as skipped; missed runs are not made up when it is back.
captainOff.noModel: Captain has no model. Choose one in Captain's settings; until then each time that comes is recorded as skipped.
captainOff.noCaptain: Captain is not set up yet. Until it is, each time that comes is recorded as skipped.
